messages:
lucas: FYI — canary clusters picked up the new activation_delay_ms default (0) and we saw KV cache churn + latency spike around 02:14 UTC. p50 ~3x for ~3m. Possible schema misunderstanding when default changed.
anika: Ugh. Any deploy trace? @ops-bot which commit/rollout touched this field?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-20T02:11:22Z - canary rollout - service=config-service image=v3.2.7 - changed field activation_delay_ms from 100 -> 0
maya: That explains it. activation_delay_ms is used to stagger prefix warmups; 0 = immediate activation -> cache misses everywhere.
sam: We should avoid reactive flips. Immediate mitigation: add a cluster-level override to enforce a safe activation_delay_ms for canaries. Longer-term: require telemetry gating and a dry-run preview in the console.
lucas: Who can apply the override now? We need to stop the spike ASAP.
anika: I can patch the override in the console quick path, but need oncall signoff. @sam can you approve?
sam: approve. Do it, and add a metric tag so we can split graphs by config-preview state (activation.preview=true/false).
maya: Also: can we add a server-side safety that treats activation_delay_ms < 10ms as suspicious and refuses to apply to >10% of traffic? Quick guard.
lucas: That requires runtime flag work; for now console override + telemetry split.
anika: Done — applied cluster override: activation_delay_ms=50 for canary clusters at 02:18 UTC. console log: `config-service.override.applied=true`.
sam: Good — p50 back to normal within 4m. Next items:
1) API: deprecate implicit default; require explicit default_activation_ms in config catalog (so deploys can't silently change global behavior).
2) Console UX: add a "simulate impact" dry-run that runs a lightweight perf simulation and returns estimated p50/p95 delta.
3) Telemetry gating: require sampled sessions to meet perf thresholds for 30m before enabling target >=20% traffic.
maya: Draft API snippet:
```
{
  "name": "activation_delay_ms",
  "type": "int",
  "default": null,
  "enforce_preview": true,
  "simulation_endpoint": "/v1/configs/simulate"
}
```
We should expose `simulation_endpoint` that runs sampled shadow requests (bounded sample) to model impact.
lucas: Do we want dry-run to shadow real requests? That gives fidelity but costs tokens.
sam: Shadowing = yes with a bounded sample rate (e.g., 0.1%). Also add drift alerts: if console preview simulation results diverge from applied runtime by >15%, raise an automated alarm.
anika: I'll create a P1 ticket for API + console UX and assign owners. Also adding a one-off safety test to the rollout playbook to cover activation defaults.
maya: I'll review the ticket and own telemetry gating. Also suggest adding an optional `activation_effective_time` so teams can schedule activations during low-traffic windows rather than immediate flip.
lucas: For short-term: do we revert the PR that changed the default or patch the catalog to null and require explicit set?
sam: Revert the PR for safety short-term. Reintroduce once API, console simulation, and gating are in place.
anika: Revert PR #4823 submitted at 02:40 UTC. I'll update the playbook and status in #oncall.
ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-034 — Activation default regression. Severity: sev3. Postmortem requested.
lucas: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Owners: sam -> API contract, maya -> telemetry gating + simulations, anika -> console UX + playbook. We'll follow up in the weekly safety triage and add a brief postmortem with actionable items.
